summary: ST-05 is a story with children: [] and no workitems/ directory: an empty story, which the planning contract requires expanded before acceptance, so this is a split. Its own scope inventory confirms this is not a leaf: at least 7 distinct deliverable behaviors (MacGuffin content with 2+ earlier environmental traces and simple-render presentation; retrieval mechanics with the changed environment/creature/return-journey effect; the final descent sequence with altered rules and instruments; the win condition as new simulation state; section-25 save milestones with autosave schema extension and migration; 2+ ending variants from one decision with credits and restart; one-shot ending-trigger and save-reload survival proof) across 4 named subsystems, far over the three-responsibility leaf limit, and none of AC-end-mac / AC-end-seq / AC-end-variants currently has child coverage. Findings are otherwise sound: depends_on [ST-03, ST-04] resolves to two already-expanded stories whose children (WI-03*, WI-04*) are reviewed; the three criteria form a cleanly partitionable floor; and the constraints are carried (no HP-bar leviathan, no arena per sections 1.5/24, final challenge from altered context per section 39, ending logic in the simulation with the browser only presenting, mechanism referenced by id only per sections 0/12/68). Required split: adopt the node's own proposed 3-way boundary as the minimum - ST-05a MacGuffin content + retrieval mechanics -> AC-end-mac; ST-05b final descent sequence (altered rules, instruments, escape) with the section-45 win condition -> AC-end-seq; ST-05c ending variants + save-continuity and one-shot trigger verification -> AC-end-variants. Each child must carry its assigned parent criterion verbatim and stay within three changed responsibilities. Assign the headless one-shot-trigger and save-reload proof (section 70 duplicate-trigger and restart checks) to ST-05c as the explicit final proof owner, while ST-05b keeps its own per-step reload check. ST-05a inherits depends_on [ST-03, ST-04] and must trace its 2 earlier environmental traces to ST-04's delivered foreshadow work (WI-04b line) inside ST-04, not deferred - per the ST-04 review. ST-05b owns the no-arena/no-HP-bar constraint and keeps the endgame mechanism private, id-reference only, consistent with the WI-01c creative pass. ST-05c owns the section-25 save milestones (autosave schema extension in src/game/save.ts with trivial migration, pre-descent and post-trigger points) and names the final proof owner of the full fresh-save scenario (reach, retrieve, changed return, both variants, reload at each milestone, restart). Downstream, ST-06's and ST-07's dependencies on ST-05 then mean all ST-05 leaves, so no change to their frontmatter. If ST-05c exceeds three changed responsibilities, split the save-system work from the variant logic and presentation work into two children instead.
